name: Origin
purpose: Main dev PC and control station; every other machine is driven from here. Sleeps, hosts nothing.

name: Oracle
kind: Samsung Galaxy Book2 Pro · Omarchy (Arch / Hyprland)
purpose: Lightweight daily driver and SSH client into Origin and Vortex; also lends Origin its camera and speakers.

name: Vortex
kind: The always-on server · Fedora + rootless Podman
purpose: Media, photos, music, files, local LLMs, monitoring and a private git forge. The production box.

name: ProDure
purpose: Isolated business box, one VM per project under Proxmox. Sourced; deploys after the network rebuild.

name: Inspiron
purpose: Proxmox rehearsal box and an independent monitoring node, so alerting survives a Vortex outage.

name: Titan
specs: 256 GB DDR3 ECC in hand (8× 32 GB)
Board, CPUs, PSU and GPU not yet chosen
Target: a 24 GB-class GPU for the hot tensors
purpose: A box for models too big for any GPU: experts in RAM, attention on the card. Platform still open.
